description: ​We are D.A.M.N Labs, a software engineering and AI R&D team building a real-time satellite telemetry harmonization platform for the MODIS and VIIRS Hot Spots challenge. Our stack includes Python (FastAPI), PostGIS, ML spatial fusion, and interactive geospatial visualization. Looking for 1–2 motivated teammates in Earth science/GIS, frontend/UI design, or data storytelling/pitching to help turn NASA FIRMS satellite data into an actionable wildfire intelligence tool. Let's build!
